items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: The Globe Hall, that was Frankie Deuce, I mean Buddy Bowling.

ctx.x: Have you seen the front of that place? It was all blown away? Yes.
I saw it yesterday, first time. Yeah. Now you take the, the hall is right there. The Globe Hall, that was Frankie Deuce, I mean Buddy Bowling. Buddy Bowling, that's right.
